```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)
library(DBI)
library(knitr)

query_postgres <- function(query, ...) {
  con <- DBI::dbConnect(
    RPostgres::Postgres(),
    host     = Sys.getenv("DB_HOST"),
    port     = as.integer(Sys.getenv("DB_PORT")),
    user     = Sys.getenv("DB_USER"),
    password = Sys.getenv("DB_PASSWORD"),
    dbname   = "mtgcards"
  )
  df <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, query, ...)
  DBI::dbDisconnect(con)
  tibble::tibble(df)
}
```

```{r data}
veggies <- c("ramp", "card_advantage", "targeted_disruption", "mass_disruption")

# labeled data
df_kf <- query_postgres("SELECT card_name, kf FROM public.labeled_kf_final")

# Single-pass results
df_single <- query_postgres("SELECT card_name, prompt_file, model, raw_json FROM public.labeled")

# Two-pass results — expose pass1 and final as separate rows with model suffixes
# tryCatch handles the case where labeled_two_pass doesn't exist yet
df_two_pass_raw <- tryCatch(
  query_postgres("
    SELECT card_name, prompt_file, feedback_prompt_file, model, raw_json_pass1, raw_json_final
    FROM public.labeled_two_pass
  "),
  error = function(e) tibble(
    card_name = character(), prompt_file = character(), feedback_prompt_file = character(),
    model = character(), raw_json_pass1 = character(), raw_json_final = character()
  )
)
df_two_pass_p1 <- df_two_pass_raw %>%
  filter(!is.na(raw_json_pass1)) %>%
  transmute(card_name, prompt_file, model = paste0(model, " [p1]"), raw_json = raw_json_pass1)
df_two_pass_final <- df_two_pass_raw %>%
  filter(!is.na(raw_json_final)) %>%
  transmute(
    card_name,
    # Encode feedback prompt into prompt_file so it shows as a distinct row in the table
    # e.g. "prompts/prompt11.md" + "prompts/feedback.md" -> prompt column shows "prompt11+feedback"
    prompt_file = paste0(
      sub("\\.md$", "", prompt_file), "+",
      sub("\\.md$", "", basename(feedback_prompt_file)), ".md"
    ),
    model = paste0(model, " [final]"),
    raw_json = raw_json_final
  )

# combine all claude results into a single dataset
df_all_claude <- bind_rows(df_single, df_two_pass_p1, df_two_pass_final) %>%
  filter(basename(prompt_file) == "prompt.md" | coalesce(as.integer(str_extract(basename(prompt_file), "\\d+")), 0L) >= 8)
# Unnest all Claude tags, keeping prompt_file + model
df_all_tags <- df_all_claude %>%
  mutate(raw_json = map(as.character(raw_json), fromJSON)) %>%
  unnest_longer(raw_json, indices_to = "category", values_to = "tier") %>%
  filter(!category %in% c("card_name", "low_confidence")) %>%
  select(card_name, prompt_file, model, category, tier)

# unnest all KF tags
df_kf_tags <- df_kf %>%
  mutate(kf = map(as.character(kf), fromJSON)) %>%
  unnest_longer(kf, indices_to = "category", values_to = "tier")

# list of valid cards to analyze
df_card_names <- df_all_claude %>% 
  select(card_name, prompt_file, model) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  count(card_name) %>% 
  filter(n == max(n), 
         card_name %in% df_kf$card_name) %>% 
  select(-n)

# dataset with KF and Claude tags in one place
df_compare <- df_card_names %>% 
  left_join(df_kf_tags, by = "card_name") %>% 
  full_join(df_all_tags %>% filter(card_name %in% df_card_names$card_name), 
            by = c("card_name", "category"), 
            suffix = c("_kf", "_claude")) %>% 
  select(card_name, prompt_file, model, category, tier_kf, tier_claude)
```


**Tag accuracy**: among all (card, mechanic) pairs where at least one of Claude or KF assigned a tag, what fraction did both agree on?
**Tier accuracy**: among pairs where both agreed a mechanic applies, what fraction matched on tier?
"Veggies" = ramp, card_advantage, targeted_disruption, mass_disruption.

```{r table}
df_compare %>% 
  mutate(is_veggie = category %in% veggies) %>% 
  group_by(prompt_file, model) %>% 
  summarise(
      n_cards          = n_distinct(card_name),
      tag_acc_overall  = mean(is.na(tier_kf) == is.na(tier_claude)),
      tag_acc_veggies  = mean(is.na(tier_kf[is_veggie])    == is.na(tier_claude[is_veggie])),
      tier_acc_overall = mean(tier_kf == tier_claude, na.rm = TRUE),
      tier_acc_veggies = mean(tier_kf[is_veggie] == tier_claude[is_veggie], na.rm = TRUE), 
      .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(across(c(tag_acc_overall, tag_acc_veggies, tier_acc_overall, tier_acc_veggies),
                ~ paste0(round(. * 100, 1), "%"))) %>%
  kable(
    col.names = c("Prompt", "Model", "Cards",
                  "Tag Acc (Overall)", "Tag Acc (Veggies)",
                  "Tier Acc (Overall)", "Tier Acc (Veggies)"),
    align = c("l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r")
  )
```
